title: Rabbit JetStream Queue
description: Typed Queue authoring contract. Legacy YAML coercions are not exhaustively modeled. Validate through server preview; schema success is not permission, resource readiness or production qualification. Defaults are annotations, never instructions to replace omitted draft fields.

labels.description: Case-sensitive keys and exact string values.

subjects.description: Use nonempty Subjects or nonempty Bindings, never both. Null is the canonical absent Subjects value for binding-based documents. Wildcards are whole-token * and final-token >; server validation is required.

items.description: Direct keys contain no wildcards. Topic supports whole-token * and final-token #. Fanout has no keys. Server validates routing syntax and generated-plan compatibility.

replicas.description: Required explicit selection; parser support is not production qualification.

maxPriority.description: Omitted priority differs from explicit zero.

maxAge.description: Go duration string, nonnegative int64 nanoseconds. Zero leaves this limit unset.

maxBytes.description: Nonnegative int64 bytes or integer B/KB/MB/GB/KiB/MiB/GiB. Server checks multiplication overflow. Zero leaves this limit unset.

maxMessages.description: Exact int64; preserve precision. Zero leaves this limit unset.

ackWait.description: Positive Go duration within int64 nanoseconds.

maxDeliver.description: Positive delivery attempts on the qualified 64-bit target.

queue.description: Cannot equal metadata.name. This field does not prove the target exists or is qualified.
